name: timeseries_split_clean
title: The correct walk-forward twin: every transform inside a Pipeline
origin: clean twin of timeseries_split; the negative REQUIREMENTS R3.7 asks for

forbidden.why: the StandardScaler is a Pipeline step, so cross_val_score refits it inside every fold - nothing is fitted before the split
no transformer is ever fitted on a test fold; the Pipeline owns every fit
the preprocessing is inside the estimator handed to cross_val_score, which is exactly the fix MLV103 asks for
TimeSeriesSplit is deterministic and the estimator already carries random_state=0
the only stochastic component, the boosted regressor, is seeded at line 30
